scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:build: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:bundle: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync ios
scripts.ios:build: npm run ios:sync && xcodebuild -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
